title: Finite-stage unit images generate inverse-limit coefficient sections
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder in Type u, S_i spectral spaces with spectral transition maps f_ij satisfying identity and composition, and (X,p_i) their topological inverse limit. Let F_i be Ab.{max u v}-valued sheaves with coherent maps α_ij:F_i→(f_ij)_*F_j. Let G:I→AbSheaves(X) be identified with p_j⁻¹F_j and have the transition formula on all unit sections. Fix i and compact open U⊆S_i, put U_j=f_ij⁻¹U and Z=p_i⁻¹U, and let n_j:F_j(U_j)→G_j(Z) be the inverse-image unit with the specified transports. For every j≥i and s∈G_j(Z), there exist k≥j and t∈F_k(U_k) such that G_jk(s)=n_k(t). This assertion concerns representation of one pulled-back section and contains neither a sheaf-colimit cocone nor a comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image].

source.place: Tag 0A32, lemma-compute-pullback-to-limit, finite-cover/gluing surjectivity argument, combined with the coefficient maps in Tag 0A33.

proof.text: The spectral inverse-limit theorem makes X spectral and Z compact. Apply the local inverse-image representative lemma to eG_j(s). Refine each base neighborhood by a compact open in S_j and each limit neighborhood by a compact open in X contained in Z and the pulled-back base neighborhood. Restrict the coefficient section accordingly; naturality of the unit and eG preserves the equality with s. Compactness gives a finite subcover.

Apply simultaneous finite-cover descent to the compact open U_j in S_j and the chosen finite base and limit neighborhoods. It gives a stage k≥j and compact opens D_a covering U_k, whose pullbacks are the chosen limit neighborhoods and which lie in the inverse images of the respective base opens.

Apply α_jk to each base coefficient section and restrict to D_a. Naturality and hGmap identify their inverse-image units with restrictions of G_jk(s). Consequently the difference of any two such sections on the compact overlap D_a∩D_b has zero inverse-image unit.

Apply eventual zero detection to these differences on the compact pairwise overlaps. Choose one common stage l for the finitely many overlaps, using nonemptiness even for an empty family. Naturality of α and its cocycle preserve the resulting equalities, so the transitioned local coefficient sections glue in F_l on U_l.
The unit of the glued section agrees locally with G_jl(s); separation of G_l gives global equality. The canonical transports in hn identify this unit with n_l. Thus the claimed representative exists.

mathlib_searches.query: For an inverse system of spectral spaces, a coefficient section whose inverse image is zero becomes zero at a finite stage, and every section on the limit is represented at a finite stage
mathlib_searches.results: AffineTransitionLimit has analogous results for scheme structure sheaves, not arbitrary abelian sheaf systems.

mathlib_searches.query: A section of an inverse image sheaf on a spectral inverse limit is represented by a section at a finite stage
mathlib_searches.results: Affine scheme and ring-valued structure-sheaf results; none applies to arbitrary abelian sheaves.

from.place: General cohomological continuity used after constructing the punctured inverse system: sections on quasi-compact opens are represented and identified at a finite stage.

theorem spectralLimit_unit_generation
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (S : I → TopCat.{u}) [∀ j : I, SpectralSpace (S j)]
    (f : ∀ (j k : I), j ≤ k → (S k ⟶ S j))
    (hf : ∀ (j k : I) (h : j ≤ k), IsSpectralMap (f j k h))
    (hfid : ∀ j : I, f j j le_rfl = 𝟙 (S j))
    (hfcomp : ∀ (j k l : I) (hjk : j ≤ k) (hkl : k ≤ l),
      f k l hkl ≫ f j k hjk = f j l (hjk.trans hkl))
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (p : ∀ j : I, X ⟶ S j)
    (hpcomp : ∀ (j k : I) (h : j ≤ k), p k ≫ f j k h = p j)
    (hlimit : ∀ a : ∀ j : I, S j,
      (∀ (j k : I) (h : j ≤ k), f j k h (a k) = a j) →
      ∃! x : X, ∀ j : I, p j x = a j)
    (htop : X.str = ⨅ j : I, TopologicalSpace.induced (p j) (S j).str)
    (F : ∀ j : I, (S j).Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{max u v})
    (alpha : ∀ (j k : I) (h : j ≤ k),
      F j ⟶ (pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} (f j k h)).obj (F k))
    (_halpha_id : ∀ (j : I) (V : Opens (S j)) (s : (F j).obj.obj (op V)),
      HEq ((alpha j j le_rfl).hom.app (op V) s) s)
    (halpha_comp : ∀ (j k l : I) (hjk : j ≤ k) (hkl : k ≤ l)
        (V : Opens (S j)) (s : (F j).obj.obj (op V)),
      HEq ((alpha k l hkl).hom.app (op ((Opens.map (f j k hjk)).obj V))
          ((alpha j k hjk).hom.app (op V) s))
        ((alpha j l (hjk.trans hkl)).hom.app (op V) s))
    (G : I ⥤ X.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{max u v})
    (eG : ∀ j : I, G.obj j ≅
      (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (Opens.map (p j))
        AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} (Opens.grothendieckTopology (S j))
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).obj (F j))
    (hGmap : ∀ (j k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k) (V : Opens (S j))
        (s : (F j).obj.obj (op V)),
      HEq (((G.map (homOfLE hjk)) ≫ (eG k).hom).hom.app
          (op ((Opens.map (p j)).obj V))
        ((eG j).inv.hom.app (op ((Opens.map (p j)).obj V))
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (Opens.map (p j)) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology (S j)) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).unit.app
              (F j)).hom.app (op V) s)))
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
          (Opens.map (p k)) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology (S k)) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).unit.app
            (F k)).hom.app (op ((Opens.map (f j k hjk)).obj V))
              ((alpha j k hjk).hom.app (op V) s)))
    (i : I) (U : Opens (S i)) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set (S i)))
    (n : ∀ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j),
      (F j).obj.obj (op ((Opens.map (f i j hij)).obj U)) ⟶
        (G.obj j).obj.obj (op ((Opens.map (p i)).obj U)))
    (hn : ∀ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
        (s : (F j).obj.obj (op ((Opens.map (f i j hij)).obj U))),
      HEq (n j hij s)
        ((eG j).inv.hom.app
          (op ((Opens.map (p j)).obj ((Opens.map (f i j hij)).obj U)))
            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (Opens.map (p j)) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}
              (Opens.grothendieckTopology (S j))
              (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).unit.app (F j)).hom.app
                (op ((Opens.map (f i j hij)).obj U)) s)))
    : ∀ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
        (s : (G.obj j).obj.obj (op ((Opens.map (p i)).obj U))),
      ∃ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k)
        (t : (F k).obj.obj (op ((Opens.map (f i k (hij.trans hjk))).obj U))),
        (G.map (homOfLE hjk)).hom.app (op ((Opens.map (p i)).obj U)) s =
          n k (hij.trans hjk) t
